title: Grok Build: ESPN odds first in process-sport.ts + CLAUDE.md pointer
brief: One job, on the Sports checkout. In process-sport.ts: call fetchEspnOddsForSport FIRST, and call OddsApiClient only when ODDS_PROVIDER is odds-api AND the circuit is closed. Leave certifiableForLiveGate false. Add one line at the top of CLAUDE.md pointing at READ-FIRST.md. Commit on a NEW branch (not main). Do NOT merge to main from the agent. Do NOT redeploy. Do NOT apply any Prisma diff. Push the branch and report the branch name.
